guidance.summary: OSAT revenue visibility of over INR 25,000 million over 5 years
guidance.speaker: Ramesh Kunhikannan
guidance.quote: In OSAT, the order outlook for both the current year and the medium term remains strong with revenue visibility of over INR25,000 million over the next 5 years.

guidance.summary: Improve Kaynes standalone EMS working capital by 8 to 10 days
guidance.quote: You can rest assured that Kaynes stand-alone, the EMS business will continue to be cash positive, and we'll be improving it at least by about 8 to 10 days in the years to come in this segment.

guidance.summary: Order book continues to be stronger at INR 9,000 crores plus
guidance.quote: Our order book continues to be stronger at INR9,000 crores plus.

guidance.summary: Rail business expected to grow by 20% to 25% this year
guidance.speaker: N. Muthukumar
guidance.quote: So rail business, I'm expecting this year to grow by around 20%, 25% because of these coming in.

guidance.summary: PCB revenue of around INR 300 crores to INR 400 crores
guidance.speaker: Ramesh Kunhikannan
guidance.quote: I'm sure and certain we will do a good number of PCB of around INR300 crores to INR400 crores, and OSAT of around INR250 crores to INR300 crores.
